component.name: Calculator
component.summary: Arithmetic, scientific, financial and programming calculations

description.p: Radix is a desktop calculator that reimplements the behavior of GNOME Calculator (target: upstream v51.1 semantics) as a clean-room Rust implementation. It ships a GTK4 GUI, a command-line REPL, a headless solve CLI and a GNOME Shell search provider from one engine.

ul.li: Six modes: basic, advanced, financial, programming, keyboard input and unit conversion
Exact rational arithmetic with an MPFR numeric core at 2000-bit precision, complex numbers and factorization
Unit and currency conversion with four exchange-rate providers
Programming mode with bit panel, binary/octal/decimal/hexadecimal bases and 8–64-bit word sizes
Variables, user functions, undo/redo and a persistent per-window history tape
GNOME Shell search provider returning answers straight from the search field

description.p: The About page was rebuilt on libadwaita's AboutWindow: app icon, accent version chip and the Website / Report an Issue / Credits / Legal rows, with real GitHub website and issue-tracker links.

First packaged release: the full engine (expression language, exact numerics, four number formats, units and currency, financial functions), the six-mode GTK4 GUI at GNOME 51 visual parity, the radix-cmd REPL, the headless --solve CLI and the GNOME Shell search provider. Packages are provided for Debian, Fedora, Arch Linux and Flatpak.
